## 新增

- **接入火山引擎豆包同声传译** — 设置 → 接口新增「豆包同声传译」（火山引擎）：20 种语言，每一对里须有中文或英文；原文、译文和语音在同一条连接里返回，不用另接 TTS。朗读默认复刻说话人自己的音色，目标语言是中英时也可以选 2 个预置音色。需要在豆包语音控制台创建 API Key，并先在「开通管理」里手动开通同声传译。
- **中英互译** — 豆包接口下，语言卡片顶部切到「中英互译」：说中文出英文、说英文出中文，一场会话里自动切换，当前说的是哪一边会亮一个点。
- **SRT 按音频时间轴导出** — 每行字幕记下它在音频里的起止，导出的 SRT 能直接对上原视频。Qwen3.5 和豆包用服务端给的时间，OpenAI 用 `elapsed_ms`，Gemini 没有时间信息，按文字到达时已送出的音频长度估算（会晚一个模型延迟）。字幕按开始时间排列、前后不重叠；旧的翻译历史照旧能导出。

## 改进

- 新安装默认使用 Qwen3.8；已经选过接口和模型的不受影响。
- 在 Qwen 和豆包之间切换时，各自记住选过的音色。
- 标题栏的界面语言按钮显示点击后要切到的语言（中文界面显示 EN，英文界面显示「中」）。
- README 新增「接口对比」：各接口的语言、朗读、连接地址与官方价格。

## 修复

- 很早期的设置文件迁移时，不再配出接口和模型对不上的组合。

## 安装与打开

需要一个 API Key：[阿里云百炼](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/cn-beijing/model/settings/api-key)、[OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) 、[Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) 或[豆包语音控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/apikeys)任选其一（豆包要先在[开通管理](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/activate)里手动开通同声传译）。首次打开后点右上角齿轮，选好接口再填入 Key。

### Windows 10 / 11

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64-setup.exe)（推荐）或 [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64_en-US.msi`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64_en-US.msi)，双击安装。
2. 安装包没有代码签名，SmartScreen 可能提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：点 **更多信息 → 仍要运行**。
3. 从开始菜单打开 ReaLingo。Windows 11 会把托盘图标折叠进 `^`，想常驻就拖到任务栏上。

### macOS 12+（Intel 与 Apple Silicon 通用）

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_universal.dmg)，打开后把 ReaLingo 拖进「应用程序」。
2. 应用没有经过 Apple 公证，首次打开会被拦下（提示「已损坏」或「无法验证开发者」）。在终端执行一次：
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   或者先打开一次，再到 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性**，在页面下方点 **仍要打开**。
3. 首次用麦克风 / 系统声音时会弹权限申请，点允许。系统声音需要 **macOS 14.4+**。

### Linux（Ubuntu 22.04+）

1. 下载 [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_amd64.deb`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_amd64.deb)，用 apt 安装（会自动拉依赖，`dpkg -i` 不会）：
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.7.0_amd64.deb
   ```
2. 从应用菜单打开 ReaLingo，或在终端运行 `realingo`。
3. 系统声音需要 PulseAudio 或 PipeWire（Ubuntu 桌面默认就有）。托盘图标不响应左键，用右键菜单里的「显示主窗口」。

## New

- **Volcengine Doubao Simultaneous Interpretation** — a new API under Settings → API: 20 languages, with Chinese or English on one side of every pair; transcript, translation and speech come back over one connection, no separate TTS. Reading aloud clones the speaker's own voice by default, and 2 preset voices are on offer when the target is Chinese or English. Create an API key in the Doubao Speech console, and switch on simultaneous interpretation under Activation first.
- **Chinese ⇄ English** — with Doubao, switch the language card to two-way: speak Chinese and get English, speak English and get Chinese, in the same session; a dot marks the side being spoken.
- **SRT timed to the audio** — each row records where it sits in the audio, so an exported SRT lines up with the original video. Qwen3.5 and Doubao use the server's own times, OpenAI its `elapsed_ms`, and Gemini, which gives none, how much audio had been sent when the text arrived (late by the model's latency). Cues run in start order and never overlap; older history still exports.

## Improved

- New installs default to Qwen3.8; an API and model you already picked stay as they are.
- Switching between Qwen and Doubao keeps the voice you picked in each.
- The title bar's language button now shows the language a click switches to (EN in the Chinese UI, 中 in the English one).
- The README gains an API comparison: languages, read-aloud, endpoints and official prices for each.

## Fixed

- Migrating a very old settings file no longer pairs an API with the wrong model.

## Install

You need an API key from [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/ap-southeast-1/model/settings/api-key), [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys), [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) or the [Doubao Speech console](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/apikeys) (for Doubao, switch on simultaneous interpretation under [Activation](https://console.volcengine.com/speech/new/setting/activate) first). On first launch, click the gear in the top-right, pick the API and paste the key.

### Windows 10 / 11

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64-setup.exe) (recommended) or [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64_en-US.msi`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_x64_en-US.msi) and run it.
2. The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Open ReaLingo from the Start menu. Windows 11 folds new tray icons under `^`; drag it onto the taskbar to keep it visible.

### macOS 12+ (universal: Intel and Apple Silicon)

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_universal.dmg), open it and drag ReaLingo into Applications.
2. The app is not notarised, so the first launch is blocked ("damaged" or "unidentified developer"). Run once in Terminal:
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ReaLingo.app
   ```
   or open it once, then click **Open Anyway** at the bottom of **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
3. Allow the microphone / system audio permission when asked. System audio needs **macOS 14.4+**.

### Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+)

1. Download [`ReaLingo_0.7.0_amd64.deb`](https://github.com/noSugarK/ReaLingo/releases/download/v0.7.0/ReaLingo_0.7.0_amd64.deb) and install it with apt (which pulls in dependencies; `dpkg -i` does not):
   ```bash
   sudo apt install ./ReaLingo_0.7.0_amd64.deb
   ```
2. Open ReaLingo from the app menu, or run `realingo` in a terminal.
3. System audio needs PulseAudio or PipeWire (standard on the Ubuntu desktop). The tray icon ignores left clicks; use "Show main window" in its right-click menu.

</details>
